what_happened.line: The Council on Aging heard a level-funded FY22 budget from the director, with salary the only rise; no budget vote was taken.
The director said a program line meant for instructors was repurposed for drive-through programs and supplies.
The board was told the state per-elder formula grant is expected to drop unless the new census count is official by July 1.
The letter about the rocks on Memorial Drive was put on hold until a survey shows whose property they are on.
Orientation and bylaws and policies items were tabled until the board can meet in person.

why_it_matters: The Council on Aging runs senior programs and services, and a level-funded request means no new money is sought, though a smaller state formula grant could leave less outside funding for those services.
The Memorial Drive rocks stay unresolved until a survey settles whose land they are on.
watch_next: The July 1 deadline for the new census count to become official, which decides whether the formula grant falls or rises.
